observability.title: Observability
observability.subtitle: Session Log runtime ledger plus Trace / Metrics / Replay as three independent modules (read-only)

session-log.title: Session Log: runtime event ledger
session-log.definition: Records what happened during a run in time order: start, thoughts, tool actions, results, and finish.
session-log.features: Keeps the full event stream, filters by session and event type, and supports export.
session-log.scenarios: Debug interruptions or errors, and replay the steps of a previous run.

trace.title: Trace: call-chain tracing
trace.definition: Links decisions, retrieval, tools, file reads, and model calls of one optimization into a single call chain.
trace.features: Shows hierarchy, ordering, and duration, with full input and output for each node.
trace.scenarios: Find which step is slow, and confirm whether a step actually ran.

metrics.title: Metrics: indicators and alerts
metrics.definition: Aggregates run events into counts, latency, failure rate, and token usage.
metrics.features: Trends by type, model, or turn, with graded alerts when thresholds are exceeded.
metrics.scenarios: Watch overall performance, spot abnormal latency or failures, and estimate model cost.

replay.title: Replay: deterministic re-execution
replay.definition: Re-runs a recorded call chain to check whether the result matches the original run.
replay.features: Self-verifies one call chain and compares two call chains node by node.
replay.scenarios: Run regression checks after changes, and investigate why two runs differ.

auto.title: Auto detect
auto.purpose: The system decides which kind of request this is and picks the handling path (repo search, clarifying questions, prompt drafting).
auto.usage: Just describe what you need. Obvious domain words (weekly report, storyboard, text-to-image) route automatically; pick a mode manually only when you need precise control.

code.title: Code engineering
code.purpose: Locates the issue in a real repository and produces an engineering-grade prompt with file and line anchors that ripgrep can re-verify.
code.usage: Fill in the project path and describe the change. The system gathers evidence, asks when needed, then returns one actionable plan.

work.title: Work & documents
work.purpose: Drafts weekly reports, summaries, proposals, emails and similar business documents.
work.usage: Describe the context and the audience; unspecified length or format falls back to a generic official style and is marked as inferred.

life.title: Everyday planning
life.purpose: Lists, procedures and advice for travel, purchases, fitness, moving and home projects.
life.usage: Mention timing, location, budget and personal preferences; missing details fall back to a generic plan and are marked as inferred.

creative.title: Creative writing
creative.purpose: Stories, naming, slogans and brainstorming output.
creative.usage: Give the theme, medium and tone; ask for several directions if you want alternatives.

learning.title: Learning & teaching
learning.purpose: Course outlines, lesson plans, revision schedules, papers and exam prep.
learning.usage: State the learning goal, current level and available study time.

data.title: Data analysis
data.purpose: Metric interpretation, cleaning and visualization plans, and report takeaways.
data.usage: Describe the data source, statistical definitions and the questions to answer; no live data is connected.

marketing.title: Marketing copy
marketing.purpose: Campaign copy, ad creatives, social posts and growth plans.
marketing.usage: Describe brand voice, channel and audience; request side-by-side variants if useful.

translation.title: Translation & localization
translation.purpose: Translation and localized rewriting with consistent terminology and tone.
translation.usage: Provide the source text and target language or region; optionally specify a glossary and forbidden wording.

legal.title: Legal & contracts
legal.purpose: Clause breakdown and risk notes for contracts, agreements and compliance documents.
legal.usage: State the document type, clauses of interest and jurisdiction; this does not replace legal advice.

medical.title: Medical & health
medical.purpose: Symptom organization, preparation material for appointments and recovery notes.
medical.usage: Describe symptoms, duration and history; this is not a diagnosis — seek care for emergencies.

finance.title: Finance & accounting
finance.purpose: Interpretation and calculation approaches for reports, tax, expenses and budgets.
finance.usage: Provide the data definitions, the period and the questions to answer.

game.title: Game design
game.purpose: Design documents for mechanics, levels, numbers and narrative.
game.usage: State the genre, target experience and platform constraints.

visual.title: Visual generation
visual.purpose: Produces image and video prompts you can paste straight into Midjourney, Jimeng or Sora.
visual.usage: Describe the scene in plain language, optionally pick a style and attach reference images; it does not render images.

av.title: Audio & video scripts
av.purpose: Storyboards, voiceover drafts and podcast scripts that are ready to shoot or record.
av.usage: State duration, audience, platform and style; unspecified items fall back to a generic short video and are marked as inferred.

operations.title: Operations planning
operations.purpose: Campaign, community, growth and content scheduling plans.
operations.usage: Describe the goal, available resources, budget and timeline.
